purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/lighting_capture_v3.py (PIE walking-height A/B captures, no persistence) and Scripts/release_lighting_v3.py (checkpointed, reversible adoption of ONE reviewed variant on the main map). Answers the flat sand-coloured, near-clipped limestone facades in runtime-diagnostic-20260908T173221Z.png. Every number is an authored proposal read back numerically; nothing here claims visual acceptance.

diagnosis.exposureLive: histogram, min 1.0 / max 16384 raw luminance (= EV100 0..14, r.DefaultFeature.AutoExposure.ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange=0), bias 0, low 10 % / high 95 %, film slope 0.9 toe 0.55 shoulder 0.30 white clip 0.02, local exposure NOT enabled (highlight/shadow contrast 1.0, no override).
diagnosis.sunLive: 30000 lux, 6500 K, pitch -30 yaw -160 (forward -0.814,-0.296,-0.5: sun in the ESE at 30 deg). East-facing facades (Ulam, gates) receive the sun 35 deg off their normal, i.e. frontal light.
diagnosis.skyLive: SkyLight 1.3, captured scene, lower hemisphere not black. Fog 0.0015 / 0.15 / 8000, volumetric off (authored tune, untouched).
diagnosis.wallMaterialsLive: 1155 slots MI_PBR_LimestoneAshlar + 335 MI_PBR_LimestoneTrim (real PBR instances, NOT flat placeholders), NormalStrength 1.0/0.8, RoughnessScale 1.0/0.95, Tint 1.0 / 1.08,1.06,1.02.
diagnosis.textureMeasured: sandstone_blocks_08 albedo sRGB mean 0.647/0.574/0.456 with per-channel std 0.021 (about 2 % contrast; p5-p95 of R 0.62-0.68); normal-map xy deviation p95 0.09 (weak); roughness 0.5 +-0.02 (uniform). The set is inherently low-contrast, so frontal sun plus the filmic shoulder leaves nothing to read.
diagnosis.conclusion: Not a placeholder, not exposure clipping alone: weak surface contrast (albedo 2 %, weak normals) under frontal 35 deg sun, compressed by the shoulder at 2-3 stops above the meter. Fix candidates: stronger normal relief and matte roughness on the two limestone instances, bilateral local exposure to keep highlight detail, and (separately reviewed) a more southerly sun so the east facades are raked.

views.basis: Exact camera of runtime-diagnostic-20260908T173221Z.png (release_frontend_flight_probe.py -DiagnosticFloors) so the coordinator's frame has a direct before/after.
Mikdash_PlayerStart [2100,0], inner court floor top 500 + 168 eye; looking west at the altar and the Ulam facade (release_capture_views view b).
Outer court [4974,0], floor top 300 + 168; looking west at the inner eastern gate wall with the Ulam facade above (release_capture_views view c position).
Proven Heikhal camera: floor top 925 + 168, 400 cm inside the doorway; menorah [-4900,300], Kodesh partition X -5600.

Mount platform deck Z 0 (mount-platform-design.json). First candidate whose eye-to-city sightline is not blocked is used: south edge looking south, else north edge looking north; the receipt records which and any blocker.
release_capture_views view f: kotel-detail manifest edge-0 midpoint + outward normal x 1000 cm, eye = traced plaza ground + 168, looking slightly up at the face.
Inside the Outer E gate vestibule (threshold max X 8100, floor 300): shaded jambs framing the sunlit outer court to the west.

baseline.note: Saved map and instances as they are; nothing applied.

why.NormalStrength: Master adds normal-map deviation x NormalStrength to the world-space vertex normal; measured deviation p95 0.09 -> 0.22 (about 13 deg) so joints and block edges shade under frontal sun. Trim gets less so mouldings keep crisp planes.
why.RoughnessScale: ARM roughness 0.5 x 1.6 = 0.8 (trim 0.5 x 1.5 = 0.75): matte limestone; removes the broad dielectric sheen that adds to the washout when looking toward the sun.
why.localExposure: Bilateral local exposure keeps local contrast while pulling the sunlit facades (2-3 stops over the meter) back under the shoulder; shadows lifted a little (0.85) so shade keeps form. Global exposure bounds, bias and film curve unchanged.

B_relief_sun_south.why: PIE-only comparison: the same relief/local-exposure changes with the sun moved from az 110 to az 140 (compass, +X east, +Y south; light direction d = (-sin az cos el, cos az cos el, -sin el) -> pitch -35, yaw -130). East facades are then lit 58 deg off their normal (raking) instead of 35. Changes the reviewed sun rotation, so it is adopted only if the captures are clearly better everywhere, including the Heikhal beam.

limitations: Captures are native PIE stills after a loading barrier and a 12 s adaptation warmup; they are technical evidence for review, not film-quality renders and not a packaged-build proof.

The CC0 sandstone_blocks_08 set stays a low-contrast stand-in for Jerusalem limestone; instance parameters can only scale what it contains. Real per-block albedo variation needs a different texture set (separate art task).
Sun azimuths are compass approximations for the authored scene frame, not an ephemeris.
